findings.claim: A current singleton-bound worker review cannot be consumed for a distinct two-target set because the same scalar prepared_for must prefix-bind each target.
Target-specific bug and feature declarations in a plural bare-close message are ignored by scalar dispatch, so feature-specific proof fields can be omitted while the hook passes.

non_claims: A singleton fixture is not actual two-issue semantic review evidence
Synthetic host-blocked critique is only a parser/verifier stimulus
